title: note.merged
description: Server verdict that two live notes referenced the same entry, kanji or grammar point. Every replica runs the merge procedure. OPS.md#notemerged

loser_id.description: The note that is tombstoned and gets merged_into_id = survivor_id. Equals entity_id.

survivor_id.description: The note that already held the reference. Never itself merged at the time the op is emitted. Differs from loser_id.
